title: Rammohan Roy and Brahmo Samaj: more bodies and reformers

boxes.title: Rammohan Roy: added detail
items: Knew **Persian, Arabic, Sanskrit, English**; Vedanta + Western rationalism
Also: ==first "**Modern Man of India**"==; Father of **Bengal** Renaissance
Went to England as **Akbar II's envoy** (⚠ some notes: 1831)
Tuhfat **1803-04**: against idolatry; English school **1822**; **Calcutta Unitarian Association**
Demands: ==fixed maximum rents== for peasants; end of Company's trading rights; lower export duties; Indianisation of services
UPSC 2025: respected Eastern philosophy **and** wanted rational approach = both correct

boxes.title: Brahmo: more points
items: Brahma Sabha: **20 Aug**; APPSC-G1 2008 options 1826/1829/1834/1836 → correct ==**1828** not offered==
No heaven or hell; **Jivatma** and **Paramatma** not one; collective prayer
1866 cause: Keshab's inter-caste marriage, Christian-influenced worship
Native Marriage Act: ==inter-caste marriage legal==, minimum marriage ages
Keshab's Bombay lectures inspired the **Prarthana Samaj**
⚠ Keshab's body is not "Adi Dharm"; Adi Brahmo Samaj = Debendranath's
